featureDefinitions.direction: +1 LONG / -1 SHORT; same shared model evaluated twice
featureDefinitions.relativeVolume5: lastVolume / meanPrevious5CompletedVolumes; zero denominator blocks, never substitutes1
featureDefinitions.minutesSinceFirstSelection: elapsed wall minutes since first valid complete Hybrid selected event of symbol-session
featureDefinitions.hybridReciprocalRank: 1 / unchanged original Hybrid rank; no inferred universe denominator or rerank
featureDefinitions.priorSelectionCount: all earlier valid complete Hybrid selections for this symbol-session, not P21 ENTER count

featureAvailability: Require observed09:00 bar, seven consecutive regular5m slots ending at T-5m, all supplied prefix bars completed/available by T, positive VWAP/volume denominator; missing is BLOCKED_FEATURES, never imputed
authorization: Supersedes ONLY prior task's no-authorized-training-dataset condition for this 58-session offline fit. No production/inference/validation unlock.

model.objective: weighted mean binary cross entropy + 0.01/2 * sum(coefficients^2)
model.observationWeights: equal session mass; within session equal eligible symbol-session mass; within symbol-session equal target-complete event mass; split each event equally between LONG and SHORT
model.missing: FAIL_CLOSED_FEATURES; incomplete +3 pairs excluded from FIT only; all events retained for stateful evaluation; no imputation

cv.ordinalBasis: zero-based indices in frozen58 session array

threshold.evaluation: Full chronological stateful replay; decision cannot access target availability or values
threshold.admissibility: At least one labeled first-ENTER in each evaluation fold; pooled first-ENTER mean net+3 > 0; median of active-session first-ENTER mean net+3 > 0
threshold.pareto: Remove candidates strictly dominated in expectancy, event Coverage, session stability (fraction of all evaluation sessions with positive mean net+3), immediate-adverse rate, mean MAE3 and mean MFE3; missing required diagnostic makes decision INCONCLUSIVE
threshold.selection: Among admissible non-dominated candidates, maximize median active-session mean net+3; then maximize event Coverage; then choose lowest threshold. No admissible candidate => NO_GO; no grid expansion
threshold.coverageDenominator: all Hybrid selected events, including feature-blocked and terminal-state repeats
threshold.opportunityDenominator: unique symbol-session; at most one first ENTER; report separately
threshold.hitRateDenominator: complete labels only INCLUDING zero returns; report missing separately

evaluation.referenceP21: 17-session used diagnostic is unpaired; no historical prior reconstruction
evaluation.candidateFreezeGate: Converged fit, admissible threshold, no material PIT/state/duplicate violations; still Development-only
